title: Weird west: blending horror and frontier without it looking goofy
excerpt: Where the B-movie line sits for horror-western art, the subtle-wrongness toolbox, and the references that work — Deadlands, The Sisters Brothers, Bone Tomahawk.
seo_title: Weird West Character Art: Horror + Frontier Without Camp
